from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json,hashlib,os,time,yaml,requests
import pandas as pd
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from research.asymmetric_stress_hazard_dr007_tushare_v1_0_2 import resolve_transport,build_request,CredentialExpiredError
ROOT=Path.cwd();R33="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_history_acquisition_v1";OUT=ROOT/R33
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def save(n,x):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),"已存在不覆盖"
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
protocol=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
for p in protocol["parents"]:assert sha((ROOT/p["path"]).read_bytes())==p["sha256"]
contract=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/"config/510300_asymmetric_stress_hazard_v1_dr007_tushare_v1_0_2.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
load_dotenv(ROOT/".env",override=False)
transport=None;preflight={"at":now(),"credentials_archived":False,"old_source_code_edits":False}
try:
 transport=resolve_transport(contract,os.environ,allow_expired_proxy_for_probe=False)
 preflight.update({"status":"EXISTING_TRANSPORT_SELECTED","credential_kind":transport.credential_kind,
 "request_auth_mode":transport.request_auth_mode,"expires_at":transport.expires_at,
 "endpoints_attempted_count":1,"fallback_endpoints_not_attempted":True})
except CredentialExpiredError:
 preflight.update({"status":"NO_VALID_EXISTING_TRANSPORT_EXPIRED","declared_proxy_expiry":os.environ.get("TUSHARE_PROXY_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT"),
 "provider_calls":0,"reason":"现有临时凭据已到期；不绕过旧有效期、不请求新订阅。"})
except Exception as e:
 preflight.update({"status":"NO_VALID_EXISTING_TRANSPORT","error_type":type(e).__name__,
 "provider_calls":0,"reason":"当前现有凭据/运输不满足原有效约束；未请求API。"})
save("现有运输可用性_无凭据.json",preflight)
ledger=[];frames=[];stopped=False
def collect(chunk):
 start=datetime.strptime(chunk["start_date"],"%Y%m%d").date();end=datetime.strptime(chunk["end_date"],"%Y%m%d").date()
 url,payload,headers=build_request(transport,start,end)
 payload["fields"]=",".join(protocol["field_list"])
 rec={"chunk":chunk,"started_at":now(),"url":url,"api_name":"repo_daily","ts_code":"DR007.IB",
 "fields":protocol["field_list"],"retry":False,"authentication_archived":False}
 frame=None
 try:
  response=requests.post(url,json=payload,headers=headers,timeout=(10,25))
  raw=response.content;assert len(raw)<=16777216
  secret=transport.secret.encode("utf-8")
  redacted=bool(secret and secret in raw)
  saved=raw.replace(secret,"[已隐去凭据]".encode("utf-8")) if redacted else raw
  name="repo_daily_DR007_amount_"+chunk["start_date"]+"_"+chunk["end_date"]+".json"
  path=OUT/name;assert not path.exists();path.write_bytes(saved)
  rec.update({"http_status":response.status_code,"bytes":len(saved),"raw_path":path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
   "sha256":sha(saved),"response_secret_redacted_if_echoed":redacted,"raw_saved":True})
  if response.status_code!=200:raise ValueError("HTTP_SOURCE_FAILURE")
  body=json.loads(saved.decode("utf-8"))
  rec["provider_code"]=body.get("code")
  if body.get("code") not in {0,"0"}:raise ValueError("PROVIDER_BUSINESS_FAILURE")
  data=body.get("data") or {};fields=data.get("fields");items=data.get("items")
  if not isinstance(fields,list) or not isinstance(items,list) or not items:raise ValueError("EMPTY_OR_INVALID_SOURCE_SCHEMA")
  if not set(protocol["field_list"]).issubset(fields):raise ValueError("AMOUNT_OR_IDENTITY_FIELD_MISSING")
  if len(items)>2000 or data.get("has_more") is True:raise ValueError("SOURCE_CHUNK_TRUNCATED")
  frame=pd.DataFrame(items,columns=fields)[protocol["field_list"]].copy()
  if not frame["ts_code"].astype(str).eq("DR007.IB").all() or not frame["repo_maturity"].astype(str).eq("DR007").all():raise ValueError("INSTRUMENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
  frame["date"]=pd.to_datetime(frame["trade_date"],format="%Y%m%d",errors="raise")
  if not frame["date"].between(pd.Timestamp(start),pd.Timestamp(end)).all() or frame["date"].duplicated().any():raise ValueError("DATE_RANGE_OR_DUPLICATION_ERROR")
  frame["weight"]=pd.to_numeric(frame["weight"],errors="coerce")
  frame["amount"]=pd.to_numeric(frame["amount"],errors="coerce")
  rec.update({"status":"RAW_CHUNK_READ","rows":len(frame),"amount_null_rows":int(frame["amount"].isna().sum()),
   "amount_zero_rows":int(frame["amount"].eq(0).sum()),"amount_negative_rows":int(frame["amount"].lt(0).sum()),
   "first_date":frame["date"].min().date().isoformat(),"last_date":frame["date"].max().date().isoformat()})
 except Exception as e:
  rec.update({"status":"STOP_SOURCE_FAILURE","error_type":type(e).__name__,
   "reason":"该分块请求/业务/身份/字段校验失败；无重试，未归档凭据或完整请求。"})
  frame=None
 rec["completed_at"]=now()
 return rec,frame
if transport is not None:
 with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
  for k in range(0,len(protocol["chunks"]),2):
   pair=protocol["chunks"][k:k+2]
   results=list(pool.map(collect,pair))
   for rec,frame in results:
    ledger.append(rec)
    if frame is not None:frames.append(frame)
    else:stopped=True
   print(json.dumps({"分块批次":k//2+1,"已请求":len(ledger),"成功分块":len(frames),"本批状态":[r[0]["status"] for r in results]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
   if stopped:break
   time.sleep(0.35)
save("request_ledger.json",ledger)
combined=None
if frames:
 combined=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True).sort_values("date").reset_index(drop=True)
 assert not combined["date"].duplicated().any()
 combined.to_parquet(OUT/"当前收件版本_DR007成交额原行.parquet",index=False)
 combined.to_csv(OUT/"当前收件版本_DR007成交额原行.csv",index=False,encoding="utf-8-sig")
summary={"at":now(),"status":"ALL_12_CHUNKS_READ_PENDING_FULL_MEMBER_CLOCK_GATE" if len(frames)==12 else "HISTORY_COLLECTION_STOPPED_NO_FULL_SUPPORT",
 "transport_status":preflight["status"],"provider_requests":len(ledger),"successful_chunks":len(frames),
 "saved_rows":0 if combined is None else len(combined),"download_bytes":sum(x.get("bytes",0) for x in ledger),
 "amount_null_rows":None if combined is None else int(combined["amount"].isna().sum()),
 "amount_zero_rows":None if combined is None else int(combined["amount"].eq(0).sum()),
 "amount_negative_rows":None if combined is None else int(combined["amount"].lt(0).sum()),
 "historical_first_vintage":"NOT_ESTABLISHED","new_fits":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,"goal_achieved":False}
assert len(ledger)<=12 and summary["download_bytes"]<=16777216
save("acquisition_summary.json",summary)
print(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
